title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 1: Solomon at Gibeon asks God for wisdom and knowledge and receives riches and honor as well.

questions.text: Where did Solomon and all the assembly go, because God's Tent of Meeting was there?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 1:3 says they went to the high place at Gibeon, for God's Tent of Meeting was there.

questions.text: From where had David brought God's ark up to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 1:4 says David had brought God's ark up from Kiriath Jearim to the place he had prepared for it.

questions.text: Who had made the bronze altar that stood before Yahweh's tabernacle?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 1:5 says the bronze altar had been made by Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur.

questions.text: How many burnt offerings did Solomon offer on the bronze altar?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 1:6 says Solomon offered one thousand burnt offerings on it.

questions.text: What did God say to Solomon when he appeared to him that night?
questions.explanation: God said to Solomon, "Ask for what you want me to give you."

answers.text: Ask for what you want me to give you
Build me a house in Jerusalem
Go back to your father's house
Do not be afraid of your enemies

questions.text: What did Solomon ask God to give him?
questions.explanation: Solomon asked, "Now give me wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people."

questions.text: Besides wisdom and knowledge, what did God promise to give Solomon?
questions.explanation: God said he would give Solomon riches, wealth, and honor such as no king before or after him would have.

questions.text: How many chariots did Solomon have?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 1:14 says he had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen.

questions.text: Solomon made silver and gold as common in Jerusalem as what?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 1:15 says the king made silver and gold to be as common as stones in Jerusalem.

questions.text: From where were Solomon's horses brought?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 1:16 says the horses were brought out of Egypt and from Kue.
